verdict.rationale: Netlify's marketing explicitly claims "Roll back any deploy in one click" [netlify-docs-5], which directly matches the story. Deploy management through the REST API and CLI is also documented [netlify-docs-14, netlify-docs-15]. The claim is a single one-line marketing statement with no in-depth documentation or hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the rollback mechanics (e.g. instant atomic rollback, scope covering functions and other assets), independent or community confirmation of one-click rollback in practice.
